sentence_stem: I have very little time today, so
correct_completion: I cannot visit you this afternoon.
full_sentence: I have very little time today, so I cannot visit you this afternoon.
acceptable_variants: I will not be able to see you.
I have to stay at home.

options.text: I have plenty of time for everything.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the speaker has very little time. A result cannot be a plentiful supply of time.

options.text: there are too many people at the party.
options.why_wrong: This is not connected to the speaker's time. The stem needs a result about the speaker's own plans.

options.text: I cannot visit you this afternoon.
I bought some apples at the market.
options.why_wrong: This describes a past action and does not explain why the speaker has little time now.

explanation: After 'so', we need a clause that shows the result of the first part of the sentence. Portuguese speakers may mix up 'so' and 'but' because both are short linking words, but 'so' always introduces a consequence.
translation: Hoje tenho muito pouco tempo, por isso não posso visitar você esta tarde.
